title: A floral frame above a quiet console
description: Explore a wall composition in which a floral frame is the primary focus and a console below acts as a visual anchor.

sections.heading: The imagined brief
paragraphs: Explore a wall composition in which a floral frame is the primary focus and a console below acts as a visual anchor. The imagined room uses restrained surrounding decoration.

sections.heading: A proposed design response
